description:
Location: Palo Alto, CA (4+ days/week in office)
Type: Full-time
Experience: 2+ years preferred in FDE, solutions engineering, customer-facing engineering, or related roles. Technical sales, consulting, or AI/SaaS founder experience is a plus.
Compensation: Competitive base + equity


ABOUT US

We're building toward a world where every company can become its own AI lab.

Goaly is an early-stage AI startup founded by ex-Meta Superintelligence Labs engineers and researchers. Our founders built the Llama Research Platform that every Llama post-training run landed on, and led post-training efficiency on Meta's Superintelligence team. Our mission is to dramatically lower the cost, time, and talent barriers to building proprietary AI — and make each generation of models faster and cheaper to build than the last.

Goaly is the autonomous performance layer for AI training. It watches every job across a GPU fleet, catches the runs that are wasting compute, reallocates what it frees up, and shows teams what each model improvement actually costs. It runs on-prem, telemetry-only, and starts read-only.

Backed by leading AI investors and endorsed by frontier AI researchers and builders, we're looking for a customer-obsessed, technically strong founding engineer who can bridge customers, product, and engineering — turning complex customer needs into successful deployments, lasting partnerships, and real business impact.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You will be one of our first Forward Deployed Engineers, working directly with the founding team, engineering, and GTM to own the technical customer journey, from the first conversation to successful deployment, expansion, and renewal.

You are the bridge between what customers need and what our product delivers. You'll understand their business and technical challenges, identify where Goaly can create real value, close critical product gaps, and do what it takes to make customers successful.

You'll own three critical areas:

 - Pre-sales — Discover, qualify, and win. Understand prospects' workflows, technical requirements, and pain points. Evaluate solution fit, identify gaps, lead technical evaluations, and partner with founders and GTM to turn promising opportunities into signed customers.

 - Bridge customers and product — Close the gaps. Translate customer needs into clear, actionable requirements for engineering. Work directly with the founding team to prioritize and resolve gaps that block adoption or deals. Build lightweight solutions yourself when that's the fastest path forward.

 - Post-sales — Deliver, delight, and retain. Own customers' technical success after signing. Support deployments, troubleshoot issues, deliver last-mile customizations for strategic customers, continuously gather feedback, and proactively drive adoption, expansion, and renewals.

This is a founding role with unusually broad ownership. There is no established playbook. You'll help define how Goaly discovers customer needs, wins technical evaluations, delivers solutions, and builds long-term customer relationships.

We are looking for someone with exceptional communication and customer instincts, strong technical judgment, a can-do attitude, and the ability to move fast and learn even faster.


WHAT YOU'LL DO


1. PRE-SALES: DISCOVER, QUALIFY & CONVERT

 - Understand customer needs deeply. Lead technical discovery with prospective customers to understand their products, workflows, existing infrastructure, requirements, and most painful bottlenecks.

 - Assess solution fit honestly. Determine where Goaly delivers compelling value, identify feature gaps or misalignment, and clearly communicate what is feasible today versus what needs further development.

 - Drive technical evaluations. Scope and execute demos, benchmarks, proofs of concept, and pilots. Define success criteria and demonstrate measurable business and technical value.

 - Remove blockers to closing. Work with engineering and the founding team to close critical gaps, address technical objections, and help prospects reach confident purchasing decisions.

 - Partner with GTM and founders. Translate technical results into compelling customer value propositions, support deal strategy, and help convert qualified opportunities into signed contracts.


2. BRIDGE CUSTOMER NEEDS & PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

 - Be the voice of the customer. Translate customer requirements, pain points, and feedback into clear, actionable engineering specifications, with context on customer impact and business urgency.

 - Drive gap closure. Collaborate closely with the founders and engineering leads to prioritize critical missing features, integrations, and technical improvements.

 - Be hands-on when needed. Prototype solutions, implement integrations, debug issues, or build lightweight customizations rather than waiting for someone else to unblock progress.

 - Shape the roadmap. Identify recurring needs across customers and turn one-off requests into reusable product capabilities.

 - Close the feedback loop. Keep customers informed of progress and ensure delivered features actually solve their underlying problems.


3. POST-SALES: DELIVER CUSTOMER SUCCESS & DRIVE RENEWALS

 - Own technical customer success. Support onboarding, integration, deployment, and ongoing usage. Ensure customers realize the value they signed up for.

 - Go the extra mile for strategic customers. Deliver last-mile customizations, integrations, and hands-on troubleshooting when needed to make critical deployments successful.

 - Stay close to customers. Maintain regular communication to understand evolving requirements, new pain points, satisfaction, and feature requests.

 - Be proactive, not reactive. Identify adoption blockers, technical risks, and signs of dissatisfaction early. Drive solutions before they threaten the relationship.

 - Drive retention and expansion. Partner with GTM and founders to demonstrate ongoing value, uncover new opportunities, and do what it takes to earn customer trust and secure renewals.

 - Build scalable support practices. Create documentation, integration guides, demos, and reusable solutions that make future deployments and customer support more efficient.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Prospects move from discovery to decisions faster. Customers clearly understand our value, and technical or product gaps are identified and addressed early.

 - Customers get real results. Pilots and deployments meet agreed success criteria, and technical issues are resolved quickly.

 - Customer feedback shapes the product. Engineering receives clear, prioritized requirements grounded in real customer needs.

 - Customers stay and grow. Strong adoption, positive relationships, successful renewals, and expansion opportunities demonstrate sustained value.

 - We get better with every engagement. Each customer interaction improves our product, technical playbooks, and ability to serve the next customer.


YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - Exceptional communication skills. You listen carefully, ask the right questions, build trust, and communicate clearly with audiences ranging from hands-on engineers to executives.

 - A genuinely customer-first mindset. You care deeply about solving customers' real problems, not simply selling features or closing tickets. You treat customer success as your own responsibility.

 - Strong technical foundations. You can understand complex AI/software systems, reason about architecture and integration tradeoffs, troubleshoot technical problems, and translate customer requirements into specifications engineers can act on. Hands-on coding experience, preferably Python, is strongly valued.

 - A bias toward action and ownership. You don't wait for perfect instructions. You identify problems, propose solutions, rally the right people, and drive issues to resolution.

 - A can-do, resourceful mentality. You're willing to roll up your sleeves, learn unfamiliar technologies, and take on whatever role is needed to unblock a customer or deliver an important outcome.

 - Speed and adaptability. You learn quickly, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-moving startup where requirements and priorities evolve.

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration. You can align customers, engineers, product leaders, and GTM around a common goal while managing expectations and tradeoffs.

 - High accountability and low ego. You take responsibility for outcomes, communicate setbacks early, give and receive direct feedback, and care more about solving problems than defending your own ideas.

You do not need to be a frontier AI researcher or an expert in every infrastructure stack. What matters most is your ability to understand technical problems, communicate effectively, learn quickly, and turn customer needs into successful outcomes.


STRONG PLUSES

 - Previous experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Customer Engineer, Technical Consultant, or technical founder.

 - Experience in customer-facing roles involving enterprise sales cycles, technical pilots, implementations, or post-sales customer success.

 - Familiarity with modern AI/ML infrastructure, including LLM training, fine-tuning, inference, agentic workflows, or performance optimization.

 - Hands-on experience with Python, APIs, SDKs, cloud platforms, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, or distributed systems.

 - Experience building custom integrations, debugging customer environments, or deploying solutions in enterprise infrastructure.

 - Experience managing strategic customer relationships, resolving escalations, or supporting customer renewals and expansion.

 - Early-stage startup experience, especially working directly with founders and building processes from scratch.


HOW WE WORK

 - Mission first, own the outcome. We take responsibility for results, not just assigned tasks. Think like the CEO of your project.

 - High agency and bias toward action. We identify problems, make decisions, and move fast without waiting for perfect clarity or detailed instructions.

 - Speed with rigor. We favor incremental, demoable progress and rapid iteration, without compromising the quality and reliability of what we ship to customers.

 - Wear multiple hats. We operate as one team. When a customer or important milestone needs help, we step outside our usual responsibilities.

 - Low ego, high standards. We communicate transparently, challenge ideas constructively, learn from mistakes, and hold ourselves accountable.

 - Continuous learning. We are curious builders who embrace new technologies, learn fast, and constantly look for better ways to solve problems.


REASONS TO TAKE THIS JOB

 - Direct impact on revenue and customer success. Your work directly influences whether customers sign, succeed, expand, and renew.

 - Work directly with the founders. Your customer insights and technical recommendations go straight to the people making product and business decisions.

 - See how frontier AI meets real-world needs. Work with ambitious AI teams solving technically challenging problems across diverse industries.

 - Unusually broad ownership. Shape the customer journey end-to-end — from early discovery and technical evaluation to engineering execution and long-term success.

 - Build the FDE function from 0 to 1. Help establish Goaly's customer-facing engineering playbook, with opportunities to lead and scale the function as we grow.

 - A high-caliber founding team. Work alongside engineers and researchers who built AI infrastructure at frontier scale, with real customers, substantial GPU resources, and a culture of fast execution.


REASONS NOT TO TAKE THIS JOB

 - You prefer working exclusively on engineering projects without direct customer interaction.

 - You are uncomfortable owning ambiguous problems that cross technical, product, and commercial boundaries.

 - You prefer handing off customers after a successful sale rather than staying accountable for their long-term success.

 - You expect detailed instructions or established processes before taking action.

 - You want a predictable, narrowly scoped role rather than the intensity, pace, and ownership of an early-stage startup.


LOCATION, VISA SPONSORSHIP & BENEFITS

 - Location: Hybrid in Palo Alto, 4+ days/week in office. Customer visits and occasional travel as needed.

 - Visa sponsorship: H-1B and OPT/CPT support available, with immigration counsel.

 - Meals & perks: Complimentary lunch, dinner, snacks, and drinks.

 - Compensation: Competitive salary and meaningful equity ownership.


HOW TO APPLY

We'd love to hear about two examples from your experience:

 - A customer problem you owned: A situation where you uncovered a customer need, navigated technical or product limitations, and helped deliver a successful outcome.

 - A technical problem you solved: Something you built, integrated, or debugged under real-world constraints — especially if it required collaborating across teams or learning something new quickly.

If you haven't worked in a formal customer-facing role, tell us about a project where you translated ambiguous requirements into a working solution and helped others adopt it.

A note on qualifications: We value exceptional ability over perfect keyword matches. If you can demonstrate strong technical judgment, exceptional communication, customer empathy, learning speed, and ownership, we encourage you to apply.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates who need them during the hiring process.
